propositions: A recalled plan-review finding is re-injected with empty evidence and no impact, causing it to replay verbatim on every subsequent review even after the plan edit addresses it, because the blanked finding is re-verified, re-decided as block, and re-persisted indistinguishably from a fresh finding.

Pass-2 validity verification cannot act as a backstop to filter resolved findings because the recalled candidate carries no grounding evidence, so the absence veto in decide.py never fires despite the current plan text containing the refuting provision.

The fix carries the prior finding's persisted evidence and impact into the injected candidate, excludes evidence-less priors from recall eligibility, and suppresses recall when material_fingerprint differs between the prior sidecar and current material, breaking the ratchet while leaving fresh-finding verification untouched.

A prior finding with no persisted grounding evidence is ineligible for recall because there is nothing to re-ground it with, and this set exactly matches previous recall injections, eliminating the self-feeding loop without requiring sidecar migration.
